**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position), no redline.**

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** delivers both preferred elements verbatim: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** independently bars any unstated "minimum-use" charge.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** has Vendor acknowledge Customer made no "minimum-volume" commitment.
- Full-document searches for minimum / shortfall / take-or-pay / volume / prepaid / unused found no take-or-pay or volume cap; the "shortfall" hits in §§ 22.2–22.3 are audit underpayment mechanics, not purchase commitments.
- **§ 2.2 exclusivity** was checked as the planner flagged: it restricts sourcing but imposes no purchase or volume obligation, so it belongs to the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here.
